### 1. Fetch the latest EU news from RSS
Using the RSS feed of the Council of the European Union, the workflow runs every morning at 09:00 and pulls the most recent press releases.
The RSS node turns each news item (title, link, content and categories) into structured items that can be processed one by one in the next steps.

**How to setup?**
*Nothing to do*

### 2. Use AI to select relevant news and store them
Each news item is looped through the AI Classifier, the model returns a JSON object with is_relevant, a relevance score and key topics. Only items marked as relevant are kept and inserted into an n8n Data Table.

**How to setup?**
- Add your Open AI Credentials and select the model
- Setup your datatable and select it in the node

### 3. Build the daily digest and send it by email 
At the end of the day’s run, the workflow retrieves all news stored for today from the Data Table.
A Code node formats them into a clean HTML newsletter (headline, tags, short description and link for each article).
Finally, the Gmail node sends the digest to your chosen inbox.

#### How to setup?
Update the recipient address in the Gmail node and adjust the HTML template or branding in the Code node if needed.
- Select the right table
- Add your Gmail credentials
 [Learn more about the Gmail Node](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.gmail)
